name: PM-KISAN
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year in three instalments directly to bank account.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Free hospital health insurance for low-income families.
benefits: Health cover up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for hospitalisation.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
description: Free LPG connection for women from poor households.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection and a subsidy support.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Guaranteed monthly pension for unorganised-sector workers.
benefits: Fixed pension of Rs 1,000-5,000 per month after age 60.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Savings scheme for the education and marriage of a girl child.
benefits: High-interest, tax-benefit savings account for a girl child.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
description: Housing assistance for economically weaker and low-income families.
benefits: Financial assistance / interest subsidy to build or buy a house.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
description: Scholarship for Scheduled Caste students studying after Class 10.
benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance.

name: PM SVANidhi
description: Collateral-free working-capital loans for street vendors.
benefits: Loan starting at Rs 10,000 with interest subsidy on timely repayment.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
description: Monthly pension for senior citizens from poor households.
benefits: Monthly pension paid to the bank account.

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana
description: Cash support for pregnant and lactating women.
benefits: Rs 5,000 in instalments for the first living child.

name: PM Vishwakarma
description: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople.
benefits: Skill training, toolkit incentive, and collateral-free credit.

name: PM Mudra Yojana
description: Loans for small and micro business owners.
benefits: Collateral-free business loans (Shishu, Kishore, Tarun categories).
